content.text: That sounds exhausting, and two hours of screaming at 1am is brutal. Long night wakings like this are common around 2 to 3 years. Tonight, try going in at the first scream and staying calm and boring. Keep the lights off, say a short phrase like "you're safe, it's sleep time," and stay close without picking him up or starting a game. If he seems upset but not fully awake, don't try to wake him. Waking him fully can make these episodes last longer.
